m: ej cl. 1. P. ejati, to stir, move, tremble, shake, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; BhP. : cl. 1. Ā. ejate, ejāṃ-cakre, ejitā, to shine, Dhātup. vi, 20 : Caus. P. Ā. ejayati, -te, to agitate, shake, ŚBr.; BhP.
a: ej I. 1 A. (epic. P.) (ejate; ejāṃcakre, aijiṣṭa, ejituṃ, ejita) 1 To tremble, shake. 2 To move, stir; dhṛtarāṣṭroyamejati Mb. 3 To shine (P.). -WITH apa to drive away. — ud to rise, go upwards.
